```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load in penguins}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

This data set describes morphological features of `r nrow(penguins)` penguins.
`r ncol(penguins)` different variables were observed. These included the bird's `r colnames(penguins[3:7])` in addition to the `r colnames(penguins[1])` of the bird, the `r colnames(penguins[2])` they lived on, and the `r colnames(penguins[8])` the samples were collected from.

The main islands these birds were sampled from include: `r  unique(penguins$island)`.
